subject: Recap + next steps: NovaMed pilot success gates & exec readout
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + next steps: NovaMed pilot success gates & exec readout

Hi Liam — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Summary of ask from your team:
- Validate Redwood as a low-latency inference layer for patient-chart summarization and triage assistance (MVP).
- Trial should be performed on de-identified sample data, run for 3 weeks, and demonstrate throughput/latency targets and quality metrics.

Proposed success gates (high level):
1) Latency: 95th percentile under 350ms on the 512-token summary workload during typical traffic (we'll provide load profile).
2) Throughput: sustained 40k tokens/minute on a single reserved pool (benchmarked).
3) Quality: ROUGE-L/clinical precision target — see attached success metrics sheet for the specific prompts and thresholds.
4) Robustness: zero PII leakage in logs; KV/prefix caching validated.

Proposed trial timeline and owners:
- Week 0 (this week): SOW and access — Neha to own procurement + SOW review.
- Week 1: dataset ingest + model profile baseline (Ben to run baselines and share the redwood-trial-plan.pdf).
- Weeks 2–3: run real-time trial, collect metrics and prompt set evals (Ben + NovaMed data owner).
- Week 4: final readout with NovaMed execs (go/no-go decision).

Action items (requested):
- Liam: confirm the internal decision owner for the go/no-go (name and title) and whether procurement needs an exact SOW before we begin.
- Liam: share the de-identified sample dataset or a link to a secure dropbox by EOD Tue (Nov 17).
- Neha: start the contract checklist and confirm the earliest DocuSign window.
- Ben: prepare a concrete runbook and the success metrics workbook (attached).

Attachments:
- novamed-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (success gates + eval prompts)
- redwood-trial-plan.pdf (technical runbook)

If that looks right I’ll sync with Ben to schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai

1) Decision owner: Julia Marks, VP Product (julia.marks@novamed.com) will own the exec go/no-go. She should be on the final readout; I can loop her once we have a date.

Subject: Trial runbook + SOW sketch and readout cadence

Hi all — following up with the technical plan and concrete asks to keep the trial timeboxed. I attached the draft SOW and a short trial runbook. Main points below.

Trial runbook (detailed):
- Environment: dedicated Redwood Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) — we use a 4-GPU slab for the pilot.
- Data ingest: secure S3 presigned drop; we will only access de-identified files, Neha to confirm access window.
- Baseline: we will run two model profiles: fast-quantized and fp16 baseline to show tradeoffs.
- Load profile: simulated production traffic for 6 hours/day for 3 days to validate P95 under different load patterns.
- Eval set: use the attached success metrics workbook for the prompts and scoring.

Concrete success criteria (from the workbook):
- P95 latency < 350ms for 512-token summaries.
- Clinical precision > 92% on the labeled eval set.
- No PII in logs; audit log sample for the trial period with redacted content.

Owners and contacts:
- Redwood trial owner: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai) — responsible for orchestration and bench results.
- Redwood security/compliance contact: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.ai) — will supply SOC2 evidence and KMS details.
- NovaMed trial owner: Liam O'Connor (liam.oconnor@novamed.com) and a data-owner (Sofia Alvarez) for ground-truth labeling.

Timeline (target):
- Nov 17: SOW ack + dataset upload window confirmed.
- Nov 20–23: baseline and configuration.
- Nov 24–Dec 8: live trial window (3 weeks) — flexible if procurement requires start-after-signature.
- Dec 9–10: internal Redwood readout + prepare exec deck.
- Dec 11–14: NovaMed exec readout window (Julia Marks availability needed). Go/no-go decision by Dec 14.

Attachments:
- draft-sow-v1.docx (SOW sketch with payment terms and estimated pilot spend)
- redwood-trial-plan.pdf (technical runbook)
- novamed-poc-success-metrics.xlsx (metrics workbook)

Procurement ask: the draft SOW includes a pilot estimate ($12k–$18k) depending on burst capacity. Neha, can you confirm the exact price bands we should present?

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
